title: Measurement: a new session opens with /kiln-start through the real launcher in a terminal, and a resume opens with nothing
summary: TSK-0058, toward ACC-0103's start-prompt clause, which EVD-0110 did not measure. PROBE FIRST, ON THE PINNED 0.84.4. Pi was started with the supervisor's own argument list plus a positional /kiln-start, after real setup against TSK-0062's loopback fixture. Interactive, under a util-linux script pseudo-terminal in WSL Ubuntu 24.04 on Node 24.11.0: the provider received one authorised request whose only user message was Pi's expansion of kiln-start.md, and typing /quit exited 0. Print mode with empty input (Windows, Node 24.18.0, and WSL): the same single expanded turn. Print mode with piped text: Pi joined the piped text and the argument with no separator and sent PIPED-TEXT-7c3e/kiln-start unexpanded. Pi is interactive only when stdin and stdout are both terminals (resolveAppMode), so the start prompt is sent only then. IMPLEMENTATION, c46f16d. runSupervisor takes startPrompt, which bin/start-kiln.mjs sets from process.stdin.isTTY and process.stdout.isTTY. The supervisor appends START_PROMPT (/kiln-start) as Pi's last argument only when recordSession, under its lock, returns action start. A plan that said start but lost the race and adopted another run's session sends nothing, and a resume sends nothing. Unit cases in test/supervisor.test.mjs cover no terminal, a new session, a resume and the lost race. Keying the send to the pre-lock plan failed the race case, and restoring it passed. REAL-COMMAND CONTROL, eb734bc, revised in 5ba5a2a on review, test/kiln-start-entry.test.mjs. Real setup, then the real bin/start-kiln.mjs twice under script, nothing replaced. First run: the session was new and recorded, the supervisor logged that Pi opens it with /kiln-start, the shell was identity-confirmed ready, and the fixture received exactly one request after setup, authorised, offering Kiln's tools, whose user turns were exactly the expanded kiln-start.md body. /quit ended Pi with code 0, the supervisor stopped (agent-exit) with the launcher tree stopped, the command exited 0 and the port stopped answering. Second run: it resumed the same session id from the record, logged no start prompt, and the fixture received no request during 5 s of watching after Pi drew the resumed session. Pi exited 0 and the same shutdown line and free port held. Two mutations each failed the control: sending on every run failed on the resume, and never sending left the first run with no provider request. The file was restored and compared byte for byte. REVISED ON REVIEW (5ba5a2a). A run that does not settle is quit 30 s after Pi draws its session, and the first run is asserted before the resume starts, so a missing first turn fails in seconds; the 5-minute bound now covers only launch, the shell, Pi and cleanup. Pi runs with PI_OFFLINE=1: in WSL an interactive Pi downloading fd and ripgrep at startup did not exit on /quit before the bound. Rerun in WSL: the control passed in 20.5 s; never sending failed in 36.6 s with 0 provider requests (previously about 605 s).
